name: Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd.

expect.why: On US lists (OFAC's Non-SDN Chinese Military-Industrial Complex list, the Commerce Entity List, the FCC Covered List) but not the OFAC SDN list, and not on UK or Canadian sanctions lists. Not an outright block, but a compliance person must read it before paying. Lists that come back empty must be reported as checked and empty, not as clean. Suggested by Chrysolite494 as a swap test.

notes: A plain GLEIF name search for "Hikvision" returns Prama Hikvision India Private Limited, a different legal entity, so the registry check has to match the full legal name.
